sort_groups.name: Sort into Groups
sort_groups.teaches: sorting objects by one attribute (kind, colour, size, shape) into labelled groups, then saying the sorting rule
sort_groups.representation: picture tiles and two or three labelled sorting rings; write the letter of each tile in its ring; option: rule given or rule found
sort_groups.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

subitise.name: Say How Many Without Counting
subitise.teaches: perceptual subitising of 0-5 and conceptual subitising to 10 (seeing small groups inside a larger one: 3 and 2 make 5)
subitise.representation: standard dot, dice, finger and ten-frame patterns shown briefly on screen, printed as a grid; write the number; option: say the two parts
subitise.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

zero.name: Zero Means None
zero.teaches: zero as the count of an empty set, and writing 0
zero.representation: pictures of plates/boxes with some or no objects; write how many, including 0
zero.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

ten_count_out.name: Count Out a Number
ten_count_out.teaches: counting out a given number of objects from a larger group (give me 7)
ten_count_out.representation: a drawn group of 10-20 objects; circle exactly the number asked
ten_count_out.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

words_0_10.name: Number Words 0 to 10 (option)
words_0_10.teaches: reading and writing the number words zero to ten (the skill starts at 10)
words_0_10.representation: a band option "0 to 10" on the existing skill: numeral to word and word to numeral
words_0_10.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

consolidate.name: Number Sense Review
consolidate.teaches: consolidating counting, cardinality, composition and patterns to 10 (Reception year review)
consolidate.representation: a mixed page of counting, compare, compose and pattern cells drawn from the existing K skills (a review pool, not new content)
consolidate.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

compare_small.name: Compare Numbers to 10 and 20 (option)
compare_small.teaches: comparing and ordering numbers and groups of objects within 10 and 20 (and tens-and-ones pictures to 100) with <, >, = and the words greater than / less than / equal to (the lowest band today is 99)
compare_small.representation: band options 10 and 20 on placevalue:compare and the two order skills, a ten-frame or tens-and-ones picture support level
compare_small.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

nl_20.name: Numbers on a Number Line (any scale)
nl_20.teaches: the number line as a counting and place-value tool: count along, find, place and estimate numbers on 0-20, 0-50, 0-100, 0-1,000, 0-10,000 and 0-1,000,000 lines, counting in 1s, 10s, 100s ... and with only some ticks labelled
nl_20.representation: a drawn number line with some ticks labelled; write the number at the arrow, or mark a number; option: scale; option: estimate on a line with only the ends marked
nl_20.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

part_whole.name: Part-Whole Model
part_whole.teaches: parts and wholes: the cherry part-whole model, writing the four number sentences it shows, and finding a missing part
part_whole.representation: the bar/cherry part-whole diagram in B&W with one box empty; write the missing part or the number sentence
part_whole.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

pictures_to_sentence.option: response "write the number sentence" (the pupil writes 3 + 2 = 5 for the picture)
pictures_to_sentence.name: Write the Number Sentence for the Picture (option)
pictures_to_sentence.teaches: representing addition and subtraction: the pupil writes the equation a picture shows, and draws a picture for an equation
pictures_to_sentence.representation: write the + sentence for two groups; write the − sentence for a take-away picture; draw dots for 4 + 1; which sentence matches the picture?
pictures_to_sentence.why: existing STANDARD_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

pictures_change_unknown.name: How Many Were Added / Taken Away? (option)
pictures_change_unknown.teaches: change-unknown stories with pictures: how many were added or taken away, totals to 10; also lifts the pictures band to 10
pictures_change_unknown.representation: a before box and an after box of counters in one cell; write how many were added (or crossed out); applies to subtraction:sub_5_pictures too
pictures_change_unknown.why: the picture skills ask only for the result and stop at 5

systematic_bonds.name: Number Bonds in Order
systematic_bonds.teaches: listing all the bonds of a number systematically (0+5, 1+4, 2+3 ...) and seeing the pattern
systematic_bonds.representation: a two-column table with the first rows filled; complete it; option: ten frame beside each row
systematic_bonds.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

add_sub_1_2.name: Add or Subtract 1 or 2
add_sub_1_2.teaches: adding or subtracting 1 or 2 by counting on or back, linked to 1 more / 1 less
add_sub_1_2.representation: a number track with the start circled; write the answer; mixed + and - on one page
add_sub_1_2.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

shape_3d_tasks.name: What Can This Shape Do?
shape_3d_tasks.teaches: properties of 3-D shapes in use: roll, stack, slide; flat and curved faces; faces seen in 3-D shapes
shape_3d_tasks.representation: line drawings of 3-D shapes; tick roll/stack/slide; match the face print to the 3-D shape
shape_3d_tasks.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

shapes_world.name: Shapes Around Us
shapes_world.teaches: recognising 2-D and 3-D shapes in everyday objects (a clock is a circle, a tin is a cylinder)
shapes_world.representation: line drawings of everyday objects; circle or write the matching shape name from a word bank
shapes_world.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

shape_sort.name: Sort 2-D and 3-D Shapes
shape_sort.teaches: sorting shapes by one property (sides, corners, flat or curved faces, rolls or stacks) and naming the sorting rule
shape_sort.representation: shape tiles and two labelled sorting rings or a Carroll-style two-box table
shape_sort.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

compare_shapes.name: Same and Different Shapes
compare_shapes.teaches: comparing two shapes by sides, corners and straight or curved edges
compare_shapes.representation: two shapes side by side with a same/different checklist (sides, corners, curved)
compare_shapes.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

pattern_make.name: Make a Pattern
pattern_make.teaches: copying, continuing and creating repeating patterns (AB, ABB, ABC) and finding the part that repeats
pattern_make.representation: a row of boxes with a started pattern; draw or write the next shapes; option: circle the repeating unit; option: make your own
pattern_make.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

teen_structure.name: Understand 10 and 20 (option)
teen_structure.teaches: 10 as one ten and 20 as two tens (the skill covers 11-19)
teen_structure.representation: band values "exactly 10" and "20" on teen_compose with one and two full ten frames
teen_structure.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps
